[Pedagogy review · High priority · opening-review · pf-6a86eb0809]
At p3-investigation-block: Add five short opening items: (a) Differentiate 5x²−3x+4. Answer: 10x−3. (b) Differentiate e^(2x). Answer: 2e^(2x). (c) Differentiate (3x+1)^4. Answer: 12(3x+1)^3. (d) Differentiate x²e^x using the product rule. Answer: 2xe^x+x²e^x. (e) Differentiate e^x/x using the quotient rule. Answer: e^x(x−1)/x². Keep the review within one page.
Also affects: p4-identify-demonstrations, p7-example-block

[Pedagogy review · High priority · missing-prerequisite · pf-2f102e2b78]
The required power-law simplification of even powers introduces ln|x| without first teaching its identity or derivative.
Before p6-investigation-part-a add: 'For x≠0, ln(x²)=2ln|x| and d/dx(ln|x|)=1/x. For x>0, ln|x|=ln x; for x<0, ln|x|=ln(−x), whose derivative is (−1)/(−x)=1/x.'
Also affects: p9-q4-b, p9-q4-d

[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-406b8d4aab]
Append parts to p14-q12: (a) Find the y-intercept of the tangent to y=ln x at x=1. Answer: −1. (b) Find the y-intercept of the tangent at x=e. Answer: 0. (c) Using these results and the tangent at x=2, write the y-intercept of the tangent at x=a, where a>0. Answer: ln a−1.

[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-5ef5623a56]
Append parts after p18-q2-c: (d) Differentiate y=log_(1/3)x. Answer: y′=−1/(xln3), x>0. (e) Find the tangent gradients of y=log_3 x and y=log_(1/3)x at x=1. Answer: 1/ln3 and −1/ln3 respectively. (f) Explain why these gradients are opposites. Answer: ln(1/3)=−ln3, so the derivative denominators have opposite signs.
